args.body: Close CATALOGUE-EDITOR-EXAMPLE-PLACEMENT under the current valid lease once you have read back offline-staging-evidence.json and worked-example-en-fr.md and confirmed the example matches the rehearsal, including manual row lookup and comparison, and records the checkout mismatch. Use the committed offline fallback as completion evidence and include what worked, the baseline mismatch, and the condition for safe integration in the lesson. If the readback reveals a concrete defect, correct the offline artifact first. Leave site files untouched and hand the evidence paths to RELEASE_PACKAGE.
